title: Vegetarian Venezuelan Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl dish inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, made with roasted vegetables and topped with a crunchy salad.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.notes: Note: Despite the name, this recipe is vegetarian, so we're using plant-based alternatives.

ingredients.name: floral
ingredients.notes: Fresh flowers like violas or pansies add a delicate touch to this dish.

ingredients.name: bowl
ingredients.notes: You'll need a single large bowl to serve this dish.

ingredients.name: veggies
ingredients.notes: Chop your favorite vegetables, such as bell peppers, carrots, and zucchini.

ingredients.name: quinoa
ingredients.notes: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.

ingredients.name: avocado oil
ingredients.notes: Use a light, neutral oil for roasting the vegetables.

ingredients.name: cumin
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of cumin for a hint of Venezuelan flavor.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Season the vegetables with salt to bring out their natural flavors.

ingredients.name: pepper
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of black pepper for extra depth.

instructions: Toss the chopped vegetables with avocado oil, cumin, salt, and pepper. Spread them out on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, roasted vegetables, and chopped flowers.
Top the bowl with your favorite salad ingredients, such as diced tomatoes, shredded lettuce, and crumbled vegan cheese.
